rules.when: The task depends on fresh news, current events, live public facts, or recent market and product changes.
rules.why: Scout/recon: Claude subscription first, then Cursor Grok only (no Claude-via-Cursor).

rules.when: The task is read-only exploration, recon, audit, or investigation with no authorized repo changes.
rules.why: Scout shape: subscription Claude, then Cursor Grok.

rules.when: The brief is to draft or revise an implementation or architecture plan for a new project, greenfield work, unclear ship ownership, or a major ambiguous change that requires product or API decisions before coding.
rules.why: Plan draft (Architect worker): high-thinking Claude first, then Cursor Grok only (no Claude-via-Cursor).

rules.when: The brief is to draft or revise a scoped implementation plan for a known ship: a medium feature, non-trivial bugfix, refactor, ops change, or research report where planning is required but the ship and shape are mostly clear.
rules.why: Plan draft (Architect worker): scoped plan profiles.

rules.when: The task is a trivial mechanical edit such as a rote rename, formatting sweep, targeted typo fix, or simple file gathering.
rules.why: Cheap profiles when the task is narrow.

rules.when: The task is a big or ambiguous multi-file feature, a risky refactor, or work that requires holding many moving parts in mind.
rules.why: Ship work: Claude subscription first, then Cursor Composer only.

rules.when: Subscription or Cursor quota is exhausted, or the task explicitly requires an API-only model family.
rules.why: API fallbacks: DeepSeek, then Hugging Face (replace model id), then OpenRouter.
